function_excerpt: Receptor for interleukin-8 which is a powerful neutrophil chemotactic factor (PubMed:1891716). Binding of IL-8 to the receptor causes activation of neutrophils. This response is mediated via a G-protein that activates a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system (PubMed:8662698). Binds to IL-8 with high affinity.
